purpose: X01: LTRA DC operating point equals the lumped series resistance r*len, on two lines with the same r*len but 2x the characteristic impedance and 32x the delay.

oracle.derivation: At DC the telegrapher solution degenerates to R*len in series and G*len in shunt; L and C carry no DC current, so Z0 and Td cancel out. lline r=0.5 len=2 and lline2 r=0.125 len=8 both give R_line=1 ohm; loop 50+1+50=101 on each. v(a)=51/101, v(b)=50/101, i(vin)=-1/101 on BOTH lines. The pair is the discriminator: a stamp using Z0 gives 100/150 on line 1 and 150/200 on line 2 (they disagree with each other); a stamp treating the line as a short gives 0.5 on both, 4.95e-3 off.
oracle.cross_check: Independent ngspice-44.2 run of this exact netlist reproduces all six values exactly (delta 0.0); see the .sp header.
